serviceArea: Newcastle upon Tyne and North Tyneside
audience: Adults registering with a new practice, and nervous patients who have avoided the dentist for years

services.name: Routine examinations and hygiene
services.description: Check-up, small x-rays where clinically indicated, and an appointment with the hygienist.

services.name: White fillings
services.description: Composite fillings colour-matched to the tooth, used to repair decay and replace older amalgam.

services.name: Crowns, bridges and dentures
services.description: Restorative work made by a laboratory in Gateshead, fitted over two or three appointments.

services.name: Teeth straightening with clear aligners
services.description: Aligner treatment for adults with mild to moderate crowding, planned from an intra-oral scan.

services.name: Anxious patient appointments
services.description: Longer first appointments with no treatment carried out, so patients can meet the clinician and agree what happens next.

differentiators: Two dentists, both registered with the General Dental Council, and the same hygienist since 2014
First appointment for anxious patients is a conversation, not an examination
Ground-floor surgery with step-free access from the street
Treatment plans are written down and costed before anything is booked

contact.address: 112 Osborne Road, Jesmond, Newcastle upon Tyne NE2 2DR

tone: Calm and unhurried. Plain English, no clinical jargon left unexplained, nothing that sounds like a sales pitch.
goals: Get new patients to register with the practice
Reassure anxious patients enough to make a first appointment
Explain what clear aligner treatment involves before someone enquires
